svg.aria-label: The workflow I want. All I do: Shazam names the song, and I search for it in my music app and tap Add to Library, maybe picking a playlist. Everything else happens on my home server: the request goes into a queue, the server gets the album or a single, whichever is best, extracts the one track, tags it, adds it to my library and the playlist, and pings me when it’s ready. No tool does this yet.
svg.text: MY HOME SERVER DOES THE REST
